lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ca8Fe4Ge4O24 (Ca2FeGeO6) is cubic with space group F-43m (No. 216); its unit cell contains 40 atoms distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Fe and Ge each in octahedral environments with six oxygen neighbors, while Ca adopts a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 oxygen neighbors. Corner-sharing between Fe and Ge octahedra and face-sharing between Ca polyhedra and Fe or Ge octahedra are observed. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 40 sites.
